diag.port: DIAG/DM on USB interface if00 (ttyUSB0 in the default composition: DIAG/NMEA/AT/Modem). capture_cell_diag auto-detects it by matching the IMEI from an AT probe on a sibling port; diagport=<path> overrides.
diag.notes: LTE-only (Cat 4, no NR radio). spc=000000 (factory default) is sent as a DIAG_SPC_F unlock before LOG_CONFIG — EC2x/EG2x (MDM9607) gate SET_MASK behind SPC, so without it the mask is silently refused and no codes emit. SDX20/SDX55 siblings (LM960/RM500Q) omit diag.spc because they don't gate DIAG. A unit with a non-default SPC overrides with spc=<code> on the source line. Subscribes the LTE subset of DIAG_TARGET_CODES (capture_cell_diag/diag_config.c is the single source of truth): LTE ML1 serving 0xB193, LTE RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB0C0, LTE ML1 idle neighbors 0xB192, LTE ML1 connected neighbors 0xB195, LTE ML1 per-cell measurement 0xB17F (per-cell RSSI with RSRP/RSRQ). The NR5G codes in the shared target set (0xB821 NR RRC, 0xB97F NR ML1) never fire on this part. interface=0 pins if00 rather than trusting the 'lowest ttyUSB' default, so a shifted composition surfaces an actionable diagnostic instead of silently opening the wrong port. GNSS position 0x1476 (LTE ML1 / gpsOne position report) and 0x14D8 (GNSS engine state) complete the set: the capture helper turns 0x1476 into a gps_fix and geo-tags every cell_observation from it. 0x14D8 is subscribed but yields no position (its parser hardcodes lat/lon/alt to 0.0 and no firmware populates those bytes), so it contributes engine state only. This list documents intent; the device decides what is actually subscribed, because diag_config_filter_supported narrows the shared set to each modem's advertised subset at handshake time. 0xB17F is emitted with version byte 5, including on a SIM-less unit. LTE ML1 serving cell information 0xB197 (per-cell DL bandwidth RB + Tx antenna ports, forwarded as bandwidth / bandwidth_rb / tx_antennas) is event-driven, not periodic: an idle window yields none, while a camp after power-on yields a few records (version byte 2; e.g. B12 5035 = 25 RB, B4 2300 = 100 RB, 2 antennas), SIM or no SIM. A 90 s window is too short: this part can take about 2.5 min to camp after power-on.
